title: TRANSFER OF APPROPRIATIONS relative to a Supplemental Grant Award for the Fiscal Year (FY) 2025 Internet Crimes Against Children (ICAC) Task Force Program.
text:

From:
Fund No. 339/70; Account No. 70A416, 2025-2026 ICAC Task Force Grant Program; Amount: $164,693

Fund No. 100/70; Account No. 001090, Overtime General; Amount: $11,099
Fund No. 100/70; Account No. 001092, Overtime Sworn; Amount: $140,400

None submitted
